name: Ishiyagane Gen
source:
Name: Gen Ishiyagane
Sex: Male
Age: Unknown
Birthday: September 21
Profession: Owner of Brahman World Cuisine
Likes: Harbor Warehouse District, People Who Are Unafraid of Him
Dislikes: Ota Matsushita
Hobbies: Reading, Meditating
Skills: Cooking (All), Crushing Rocks

[Past]
He runs a restaurant called Brahman in Golden Yokocho. Since his face scares people, he usually wears a cute mask. So strong he could destroy a tank with his bare hands.
[Present]
He still runs a restaurant called Brahman in Golden Yokocho. Nothing has changed. Maybe he's afraid of change.

[From the in-game character descriptions]

[spoiler]Gen was the subject of genome experiments at Horadori Institute. He was born with a deformed face and body, and rough skin like rock.
Most appearances of "Gen" in the Present (except for Feb 13 or otherwise stated) is actually [url=/c85451]Kaname Date[/url] wearing a disguise.[/spoiler]
